title: UNGA Day 4: Lebanese on deck after defiant Netanyahu speech
summary: A day after a divisive speech by Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu, the prime minister of Lebanon will address the UN General Assembly. Leaders from Pakistan and Iraq are also set to speak on the…
byline: Wesley Dockery, Mark Hallam, Felix Tamsut, Jon Shelton

image.caption: Netanyahu spoke to a sparsely-populated chamber after a mass walkoutImage: Heather Khalifa/AP Photo/picture alliance

blocks.text: We are resuming our coverage of the United Nations General Assembly on Friday, September 25.
The general debate is scheduled to begin its fourth day of the assembly at 9 a.m. New York time (1300 UTC).
Iraq, Pakistan, Lebanon and others are to speak in today's morning session, while countries such as Egypt, Mexico, Kazakhstan and Sweden will take the stand in the afternoon.
Friday's debate comes after a day of speeches that was centered on Gaza, with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's address sparking a walkout by several delegates.
